name: io.github.proofable/mcp
title: Proofable MCP
description: Hosted MCP connection for Proofable identity, permissions, and verification.

tools.name: proofable_context
tools.description: Start here. Returns the signed-in profile, available verifiers, and the recommended workflow in one call. Handles signed-in and offline modes, no separate profile tool needed.

tools.name: proofable_verifiers_catalog
tools.description: Full verifier catalog: supported networks and required inputs. Use this when a verifier needs schema details beyond the compact verifierSummary in proofable_context.

tools.name: proofable_proofs_check
tools.description: Does this wallet already have the required proofs? Returns pass or fail, not records. To read proofs, use proofable_proofs_get. Omit the wallet when signed in.

tools.name: proofable_verify
tools.description: Create or refresh a portable proof after confirming that one is needed. Omit the wallet when signed in; the session authorizes the request. Signed-in ownership proofs finish here. Share a hosted link only when this tool returns one.

tools.name: proofable_verify_or_guide
tools.description: Reuse a qualifying portable proof or return the one next step needed to finish verification. Omit the wallet when signed in. Signed-in ownership proofs continue with proofable_verify. A hosted link is returned only for an outside login, payment, or different account.

tools.name: proofable_proofs_get
tools.description: Read proofs. Search by text, tag, or check; newest first; or fetch one by proof id. For pass or fail, use proofable_proofs_check. Omit the wallet when signed in.

tools.name: proofable_agent_link
tools.description: Confirm the agent is linked to your profile with the identity and permissions it needs. A separate spend account also needs signed limits.

tools.name: proofable_agent_create
tools.description: Create or import an agent on your profile. Default: signed-in account. Optional separate spend account and controls. Use agentWallet "generate" for a dedicated key. Keep the same agentId on retries.

tools.name: proofable_agent_mount
tools.description: Load the agent identity, permissions, skills, and context into this project.

tools.name: proofable_secret_create
tools.description: Store a secret, such as an API key, as an encrypted record. Tools never return the saved value.

tools.name: proofable_secret_list
tools.description: List saved secret names, types, and update times without exposing their values.

tools.name: proofable_secret_revoke
tools.description: Revoke a saved secret so it can no longer be used.

examples.title: Start every session
examples.description: Load trust context before actions or authorizations.
examples.prompt: Use Proofable before taking sensitive actions. Start with proofable_context, then follow the returned workflow.

examples.title: Register an Agent
examples.description: Confirm agent identity and delegated authority before it acts.
examples.prompt: Verify this agent is trusted before it runs tools. Use proofable_agent_link first; use proofable_agent_create only when setup is still missing.

examples.title: Reuse Portable Proofs
examples.description: Check existing proofs before opening a new verification flow.
examples.prompt: Check whether I already have the required portable proof before verifying again.
